responsibility: This header declares the source-search subsystem used by the mc front end. It exports routines to initialize or prepend compiler search paths, locate arbitrary source files or module definition/implementation files, and override the default module filename extensions, defining the public interface for module source resolution.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the public interface for the search subsystem, declaring path initialization, source lookup, and extension-setting entry points. Unlike the same-stem .cc file, it does not maintain search-path state or implement directory scanning and filesystem existence checks.
